title: the tracked pre-commit hook source checks out LF on every box
intention: cairn/.gitattributes pins cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit to eol=lf, so the tracked hook source checks out LF on every box.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: git check-attr eol for cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit reads unspecified under the current .gitattributes
traces_to: Law 3: one tracked source has to be the same bytes on every box; Law 4: enforced by git's attributes, not by the installer happening to normalise.
how: Add `cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit text eol=lf` to .gitattributes beside the other shell-script pins. Proof in a new file beside the 88e30cde9bd4 proof, same pattern: copy the real .gitattributes into a scratch git repo and read git check-attr eol for that path (lf) and for a neighbour path in hooks/ that is not the hook (not widened). The 88e3 proof is not edited. No tester code changes.

clauses.claim: git check-attr eol reads lf for cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit under the repo's .gitattributes, where it read unspecified before
the pin names the one file: a sibling path under hooks/ still reads unspecified

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.
